post.description: Maestro is an agent-native video producer: describe the video you want in `prompt` (optionally attaching reference images/videos/audio via `file_urls`) and a headless creative director plans, generates the assets (images, voiceover, music, clips), composes and renders a finished, captioned video. This is an async job — it returns a `task_id` immediately; poll `POST /maestro/tasks` for the result, or supply `callback_url`. Use `action: remix` / `edit` / `extend` with `ref_task_id` to iterate on a previous video.

prompt.description: Natural-language brief describing the video to produce (the topic, what to show, tone, audience). The agent decides the script, visuals, voiceover and edit.
prompt.example: 用 20 秒讲清楚什么是向量数据库,适合零基础观众,结尾给一句记忆点

action.description: Production action. Lite supports generate/edit; Standard adds remix; Pro adds extend. remix/edit/extend require `ref_task_id`.

ref_task_id.description: Required when `action` is remix / edit / extend: the task_id of the previous video to start from.

file_urls.description: Optional reference media (image / video / audio URLs) the agent can use — e.g. a product shot or logo to feature, footage to caption.

langs.description: Output languages. Lite supports 1, Standard up to 2, and Pro up to 4. The first is primary; each additional delivered language is billed +6 credits.

aspect.description: Required output aspect ratio. Lite renders 720p/24fps; Standard and Pro render 1080p/30fps.

duration.description: Target video length in seconds. Lite: 5–30; Standard: 5–120; Pro: 5–300. Successful jobs are billed by actual delivered duration, never above the requested duration.

scenario.description: Production route. Lite supports auto/narrated/captions; Standard adds avatar; Pro adds drama. `captions` requires source video in `file_urls`; `avatar` requires a portrait. avatar bills at 1.15× and drama at 1.35×.

style.description: Optional visual-style preset — expressed through typography, palette, motion, image treatment and pacing. Orthogonal to `scenario` (it does NOT change routing). `auto` (default) lets the director pick; every other value adopts a real named look: `cinematic` = dark film-noir (black + blood-red, Oswald); `glass` = Apple / iOS-26 frosted liquid glass; `luxury` = timeless near-black + indigo, huge whitespace; `swiss` = precise grid + electric blue + oversized numerals; `modern` = clean light SaaS; `editorial` = cream magazine + serif; `warm` = intimate cream + amber; `vibrant` = festive folk colour; `neon` = electric neon glow; `mono` = grayscale, type-led; `pastel` = soft candy pastels; `bold` = huge poster type; `industrial` = raw glitch + rust; `futuristic` = particle glow. A freeform string is also accepted as a soft hint.

voice.description: Optional narration voice — the **timbre** of the voiceover, independent of language. `auto` (default) lets the director pick a fitting voice. Every preset is cross-lingual: the same voice speaks whatever language(s) you set in `langs`, so choose purely by character — `warm-female`, `bright-female`, `anchor-female`, `clean-female`, `calm-male`, `deep-male`, `documentary-male`, `energetic-male`, `storyteller-male`. Advanced: a raw 32-character Fish `reference_id` is also accepted. For `drama` / `avatar` this sets the primary / narrator timbre; distinct characters may still get their own.

callback_url.description: Optional. Fired with the result when the task reaches a terminal state (succeeded / failed).

201.description: Job created; poll POST /maestro/tasks with the task_id.

400.description: Bad request (missing prompt or invalid fields).

403.description: Forbidden (insufficient balance, restricted access, or private option).

error.message: The available balance is insufficient for this request.
Too many requests. Try again later.

trace_id.description: Request trace ID for support and diagnostics.
